labels.rationale: The acknowledgment returns from clk_b directly into ack_sync1, which immediately participates in the equality controlling req_toggle. There is no second exact acknowledgment synchronization stage before functional use. The forward request chain does not repair the return leg.

The reverse acknowledgment is sampled once into ack_sync1, then used combinationally in the request next-state condition. There is no second metastability containment stage before functional use. The request leg is correctly two-stage; that does not repair the return leg.
